# Model and provider marks

Bundled locally on 2026-10-22. No runtime CDN or package dependency.

- `bytedance.svg` (Seedance provider), `minimax.svg`, `qwen.svg`: original monochrome SVGs from [Lobe Icons](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons), commit `ab8cbcc6ce806b923c547628132957c8a8b61509`, `packages/static-svg/icons/`. MIT license included in `LICENSE`; marks remain the property of their respective owners.
- `libtv.svg`: LibTV platform mark (`logo-l`) from the official site's icon bundle, https://www.libtv.com/icons/libtv.json?v=fb022ccc. Used to identify Lib Image's platform, not to assert an underlying model family. This mark is not covered by the Lobe Icons MIT license; original brand rights remain with LibTV.

Unknown models retain the bundled Remix generic model icon. Model labels and serialized IDs are unchanged.
